dct_creator_sm: Brindle, John (Department of Population Medicine. Ontario Veterinary College. University of Guelph).
dct_description_sm: The supplementary material consists of two causal diagrams and the survey provided to producers. Supplementary Figure S1. Causal diagram for the relationships between management characteristics associated with acceptable lift methods. Supplementary Figure S2: Causal diagram for the relationships between management characteristics associated with assisting a down cow to standing within 1 hour.
dct_title_s: Supplemental figures and survey for: Factors influencing Ontario dairy producers’ management and care of down dairy cattle
